name: finger_bass
description: what it is and how it is played
character: A round fingerstyle bass that owns the low end: roots and fifths on the one, a walking turnaround on every fourth bar, centre-left.
sources: Scaffolded for the latest implementation (2026-11-28): the preset declares its sound family so the family laws (velocity brightness, attack) apply, and carries its own placement. Levels and EQ are starting values for this piece.

Family override: the plucked family's velocity-driven saturator is off on this bass (drive_k 0): a 35 ms hole appeared 70 ms into the first note after each declared rest (stem.dropout, 51.5 s) with the saturator and its level-restore on; the brightness filter stays.
